NEAR HACKATHON is now live with $250K+ in prizes.

No signup. Just ship a public repo + public demo post between November 1st & Nov 14, 23:59 UTC.

Build on NEAR Intents, chain signatures, chain abstraction, NEAR AI Cloud, & more.

Full details: https://t.co/mkP9hKatU4
